Hi Jamie / Aaron —

Thanks again for taking the time today — helpful to hear how SkylineOps is thinking about embedding LLM features into your developer portal (search, code/SQL assist, and an internal knowledge retriever). Quick recap:

- Goal: faster time-to-insight for internal support engineers, reduce manual KB lookups
- Success criteria discussed: <25% reduction in average support handle time; confidence gating on PII filtering
- Technical constraints: currently GCP-only, strict egress controls, need SOC2 evidence for data handling

If that sounds right, next step is a short 30‑minute product intro/demo that shows the runtime, routing/fallback controls, and how we handle private deployment options. To make the demo productive, please confirm the attendee who can speak to infra/network constraints (SME).

Proposed slots (Pacific time) — pick 1 or tell me alternatives that week:
1) Thu Nov 12 — 10:00–10:30 PT
2) Thu Nov 12 — 14:00–14:30 PT
3) Fri Nov 13 — 09:00–09:30 PT

Prep materials attached: one‑pager and a short demo agenda. If you prefer, we can do a quick 15‑minute security pre-call with Dylan (our infra lead) before the demo — he can answer VPC/KMS/Kerberos questions.

Next actions: pick a slot and nominate SME(s) to invite. I’ll send a calendar invite once we lock a time.

Thanks —
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
